description: Search digitised research items. Filters are AND-combined; empty results suggest a filter to relax or a stored place name. export links all matches as a file.

added_since.description: Added to AMIRA on or after this ISO date

collection.description: Item-set title (partial) or id from list_collections

contributor.description: A person/organisation credited on the item; either name order works

country.description: Country only, exact name or common alias ('Côte d'Ivoire' = 'Ivory Coast'). Use `location` for cities

export.description: Return a file link instead of rows

has_media.description: true: only items with digitised files

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the title, description, abstract, contents or identifiers; quote a phrase to match it exactly

language.description: Name or ISO code — 'French', 'fr', 'fra' and legacy 'fre' all match

location.description: A place at ANY level of the city→country hierarchy: 'Nigeria' finds Lagos items, 'Lagos' finds only Lagos

location_id.description: Exact location authority ID, including descendants; avoids homonym matches

modified_since.description: Changed on or after this ISO date

subject.description: Subject heading, partial (e.g. 'Architecture'). Subjects absorb the former free-form tags — there is no tag filter

university.description: ubt | unilag | ujkz | ufba | external — code or full name

year_from.description: Keep items whose content dates overlap from this year

year_to.description: Keep items whose content dates overlap up to this year

name: search_research_items
title: Search research items
